title: First professional job with Johnny Pernodon, about 1915
summary: With $25 saved from a hotel job he bought drums and played a political job for Pernodon the same day, about 1915.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: No, I think after me, you know. He came after me. After me. My first job was with, remember Johnny Pernodon? Yeah. When I was working at Sancho Hotel. That's right. And I saved that money. My mom told me to take that $25 and pay on a set of drums. Yeah. And the same day I got the drums, Johnny Pernodon needed a drummer. Uh-huh. And they came by the house in Harvard. That was my first job. We played for some campaign down on the Center Rock and Charter. By a bar. I mean, political thing, you know what I mean?
He used to break all the scenes out of my mother's chairs. Playing drums.
And that was my first job. To play professionally, you know. From then on, I went on up.
